Újbuda (11. kerület) — Budapest, Hungary

Average day Average night

In detail

A large, mostly middle-class and university district on the Buda side (technical university campus, Gellért Hill's southern slopes). It is not named among the nightlife or violent-crime hotspots, but a 2022 police-data comparison found District XI led the city in the broader "burglary theft" legal category (161 cases) and was a close third for narrow residential burglary (99 cases, just behind Óbuda's 101); it is also separately named as Budapest's leading district for car theft. A genuine property-crime caution area rather than a violent one. Sources checked: Index.hu, 16 May 2022 (district burglary comparison, PRE-STAT data); BPhirek.hu, 1 Jun 2023 (district vehicle-theft leaders).
